title: When Graph Neural Network Meets Causality: Opportunities, Methodologies and An Outlook
reasoning: The paper is a survey of causality-inspired Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) focusing on technical aspects of trustworthiness such as out-of-distribution generalization, explainability, and algorithmic fairness in domains like finance and criminal justice. It does not evaluate, benchmark, or discuss religious, moral, or ethical frameworks or values.
